verdict.rationale: x402 is itself an HTTP-native API protocol. Its first-party docs describe the 402 payment handshake, a hosted Facilitator API for verify/settle, and public Bazaar discovery APIs with a generated OpenAPI client. A runtime probe confirmed the keyless discovery endpoint returns live listings, and the facilitator endpoint auth-gates as documented. The protocol SDK is also published on npm. missing for 10: a publicly retrievable OpenAPI spec (probed doc paths returned 404), detailed facilitator endpoint reference documentation in the pack, independent hands-on reports of driving the facilitator API end-to-end.
